R3-184937 5G band management and Iuant interface Type: other For: Approval Source: Huawei Discussion: NTT Docomo: We don’t agree with some aspects of this proposal. we should proceed with the current status, allow RAN4 to discuss and not wait for ASIG. (AISG v3 is not yet piblished) Huawei: preference is to wait. Ericsson: Agrees with the intention brought by Huawei. There are two annoying aspects every time a new spec is introduced: 1) Having CRs every time a band is introduced into a spec which has nothing to do with any band. The CRs are copy-pasts from RAN4 specs, thus can simply add a pointer. 2) Iuant interface: we maintained code points but they are not for any functional use. ZTE: Is there any impact on the current 5G architecture. Why is the issue brought so late. Chairman: Because we had more urgent things to do before. Huawei: Agrees with the chairman statement. Samsung: There are no 461/466 CRs endorsed. We agree with the proposal to find a good way to proceed. Ericsson: 466 is out of the scope of RAN4. Telecom Italia: Can you clarify the intention? will we skip this function? Huawei: Maitain the function. The question is how to capture the function. The goal is to minimize the work and no changes every time a band introduced. Agreement: We maintain this functionality; we should find the most appropriate way to capture it in the NR specs. NTT Docomo: we should not wait for ASIG. We should discuss on the basis of the current status (v2). Huawei: we will have to support AISG v2 but the question is how to specify Decision: The document was noted. R3-184938 [Draft] Antenna Interface Function support in 5G Type: LS out For: Approval to RAN4 Source: Huawei Discussion: Nokia: Remove reference to 25.466. It is out of RAN4 scope anyways. ==> Revised to: - Remove reference to 25.466 - Fix some editorial errors Decision: The document was revised to R3-185103. R3-185103 Antenna Interface Function support in 5G Type: LS out For: Approval to RAN4 Source: Huawei (Replaces R3-184938) Discussion: Final Decision: The document was approved.

{"chunk_id":"R3-258105-001","collection":"ran3_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["ZTE"],"tdocNumber":"R3-258105","title":"Discussion on R17 and R18 PWS for NTN feature removal alignment between RAN and SA"},"point_id":"8780280924856471018"}
ter evaluating the requirement of SA1, CT1 decided to introduce the support for PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-19 and sent the LS to SA1[1]. Then, in SA1#110 meeting, SA1 has agreed to align the stage 1 specifications to reflect the support for PWS over satellite NG-RAN from Rel-19 and replied the LS to CT1 and RAN3[2]. Meanwhile, in RAN3#128 meeting, RAN3 has also discussed this issue and agreed to remove the support of PWS for NTN in R17/R18. And the reply LS from RAN3 is given as below[3]. The RAN plenary discussion was raised in RAN#108, and the correspopnding stage 2 CRs endorsed by RAN3 (and subsequently agreed by RAN2) were not approved. These CRs were related to support of PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-17 and Rel-18. RAN discussed the issue that was originally identified by CT1 and concluded that it might not have impact on the NG-RAN. A Reply LS on removal of support of PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-17 and 18 was approved in RP-251859 [4] as below. In CT#109 meeting, CT approved the corresponding LS in CP-252246 [5]. Based on the above incoming LS, SA2 discussed the misalignment issue and decided to support both PWS for NR NTN and PWS for IoT NTN from R17 as shown in the incoming LS in R3-258010 [6]. Discussion However, after such a long inter-TSG WGs discussion, there is still misalignment between CT1 and SA2 specs. There is no ambiguity that PWS for NR NTN will be supported from R17, therefore no impact on RAN3 specs. But for PWS for IoT NTN, according to CT1 spec in TS23.041, PWS for IoT NTN can only be supported from R19, the red text is introduced in R19. The present document describes the Cell Broadcast short message service (CBS) for GSM and UMTS. For GSM it defines the primitives over the Cell Broadcast Centre - Base Station System (CBC-BSS) interface and the message formats over the Base Station System - Mobile Station (BSS-MS) interface for Teleservice 23 as specified in 3GPP TS 22.003 [2]. For UMTS it defines the interface requirements for the Cell Broadcast Centre – UMTS Radio Network System (RNS) interface and the radio interface requirements for UMTS Radio Acces Networks to support CBS as specified in 3GPP TS 22.003 [2]. The present document also describes the Public Warning System (PWS) for GSM, UMTS, E-UTRAN, satellite E-UTRAN, NG-RAN, and satellite NG-RAN, see 3GPP TS 22.268 [28]. While for the CRs attached in the incoming LS from SA2, PWS for IoT NTN tends to be supported from R17 which is conflict with CT1 spec. Therefore, it’s difficult for RAN3 to understand what’s the real intention on supporting PWS for IoT NTN from SA/CT side. This issue has been acked by some SA2 companies, which needs to be further checked and discussed in Nov SA2 meeting, and the coclusion needs to be confirmed in Dec RAN/SA/CT plenary meeting. Proposal 1: The misalignment still exists among SA/CT WGs, the corresponding potential RAN3 spec impact shall be discussed after Dec RAN plenary meeting. 3. Conclusion Proposal 1: The misalignment still exists among SA/CT WGs, the corresponding potential RAN3 spec impact shall be discussed after Dec RAN plenary meeting. 4. Reference [1] C1-250715, LS on stage 1 requirements for the support for PWS over satellite NGRAN in Rel-17, CT1 [2] S1-252393, Reply LS to LS on stage 1 requirements for the support for PWS over satellite NGRAN in Rel-17, SA1 [3] R3-253867, Reply LS on stage 1 requirements to support PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-17, RAN3 [4] RP-251859, Reply LS from RAN on removal of support of PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-17 and 18, RAN [5] CP-252246, Reply LS on removal of support of PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-17 and 18, CT [6] R3-258010, Reply to Reply LS on removal of support of PWS over satellite NG-RAN in Rel-17 and 1

CB: # 20_eNBarchEvo - Check BL CRs and check details of spec transfer in 38.46X CRs and draft TS37.48X specs - Check the details of the proposed TPs, if agreeable, they will be agreed as R17 TPs to 38.46x, and shall be reflected in TS37.48X with visible remarks (HW - moderator) Summary of offline disc R3-221012 Propose the following: Endorse BL CRs in R3-220043, R3-220016, R3-220017, R3-220044, R3-220018 and R3-220019 Agree TPs in R3-220645, R3-220468 and R3-220249 LTE_NR_arch_evo_enh-Core BL CRs will be "endorsed" and TPs will be "agreed" at RAN3#114bis-e meeting, and minute that due to the shift from 38-series to 37- series specs in connection with REL-17 WI LTE_NR_arch_evo_enh-Core, the corresponding change was included in TS 37.48X v0.1.0 spec. Note that if the draft TS 37.48x are agreed, each spec rapporteur should reflect the endorsed BL CRs (R3-220044, R3-220018 and R3-220019) and agreed TPs (R3-220645, R3-220468 and R3-220249) in TS 37.48x with visible remarks and then submit TS 37.48x v0.1.0 at the RAN3#115-e meeting. The following CRs will be modified and agreed/endorsed based on further review. Agree CR to 38.460 in R3-221108 (rev of R3-220852) Agree CR to 38.462 in R3-221109 (rev of R3-220918) Agree CR to 38.463 in R3-221118 (rev of R3-220635) Agree CR to 38.461 in R3-221116 (rev of R3-220843) Agree draft TS 37.480 in R3-221119 (rev of R3-220846) Agree draft TS 37.482 in R3-221120 (rev of R3-220919) Agree draft TS 37.483 in R3-221121 (rev of R3-220634) Agree draft TS 37.481 in R3-221117 (rev of R3-220844) Moderator’s note: There is a set of baseline CRs [1]-[6] submitted as required. Proposal: Endorse the baseline CRs in [1] to [6] Please provide your comments for proposal in the table, if any.

RX in the paging area (in fact, cell also need to broadcast the support for eDRX in System Information). Therefore, both the 10bits and 12bits UE identity index shall be provided together to the paging cell. Observation 2: Anchor gNB does not know whether an UE configured with eDRX will really use eDRX in the paging area (cell also need to broadcast the support for eDRX in System Information). Therefore, both the 10bits and 12bits UE identity index shall be provided together to the paging cell. In addition, we find that similar issue has been raised in Rel-16 for eMTC at the RAN3#111 meeting, and CRs [1][2] for NGAP and XnAP were approved. In these two CRs, the new Extended UE Identity Index Value IE is introduced over NGAP and XnAP for eMTC. To minimize the impact on the specs, we propose to reuse this IE for NR by revising the semantics description as "specified in TS 36.304 [29] " for NGAP and XnAP as below, and to add a new Extended UE Identity Index Value IE over F1AP.
